summary_en.mandatory_from: 1 January 2022. Previous Slovak Missal editions forbidden from this date.
key_changes: New Slovak Roman Missal per editio typica tertia (KBS decree prot. no. 127/2021, 1 April 2021)
New Eucharistic Prayer doxology: 'v jednote Ducha Sväteho' (in the unity of the Holy Spirit)
New conclusion formula for prayers: same change
New consecration words wording (closer to Latin original: 'za mnohych' = 'pro multis' = 'for many')
New response at Offertory preparation: 'Požehnaný Boh naveky' (Blessed be God for ever)
Additional feast formularies added to Slovak liturgical calendar
